description: This file defines the SnapshotServer class which manages snapshot serving, resource loading, and snapshot information retrieval for a trace or debugging system within the Playwright project.

classes.name: SnapshotServer
classes.description: A class that handles serving snapshots, screenshots, and resources related to trace snapshots.

methods.name: serveSnapshot
methods.description: Serves an HTML snapshot based on page or frame ID and search parameters.

methods.name: serveClosestScreenshot
methods.description: Serves the closest screenshot resource for a given page or frame ID.

methods.name: serveSnapshotInfo
methods.description: Provides JSON information about a specific snapshot.

methods.name: serveResource
methods.description: Serves a resource associated with a snapshot, handling content type and cache headers.
